name: observational-memory
description: Compaction as observational memory: in the background, an Observer (GPT-5.6 Luna through pi) turns each ~10k-token chunk of the conversation into timestamped, prioritized observations (up to four chunks at once), quoting the user's corrections verbatim, a Reflector condenses the other observations when they grow, and compaction itself cuts at the observed watermark with no model call, keeping recent messages whole. Skills in use are carried across compactions, and an om_recall tool searches the full transcript.
